blocks.text: 46" Metal Garden Trellis, 3-Section Plant Trellis for Climbing Plants Indoor & Outdoor, Plant Support for Roses, Vines & Vegetables, 1 Pack, Black

items.label: 46” Modern Plant Support for Climbing Plants
items.value: Sturdy and reliable, this trellis supports climbing plants like roses, jasmine, clematis, tomatoes, and more, encouraging healthy, vertical growth instead of spreading. No tools required – easily install in minutes for a quick garden upgrade.

items.label: 3-Section Modular Design – Easy Assembly
items.value: Designed in 3 detachable sections for convenient shipping and simple installation. Just connect and insert—no tools required.

items.label: Upgraded 6mm Metal for Long-Lasting Strength
items.value: Thicker than standard 3mm/4mm/5mm trellises, this durable metal construction is built to support vines , ensuring that your plants stay upright. Built to last season after season.

items.label: 22cm (8.66”) Deep Ground Stakes for Superior Stability
items.value: The long, deep stakes provide reliable anchoring, ensuring the trellis stays firm and steady, providing support for your garden.

items.label: Rust-Resistant Coating for Enhanced Durability
items.value: The powder-coated finish protects against rust, corrosion, and outdoor elements like rain, sun, and wind. Keep your trellis looking beautiful and working great for years—rain or shine.

items.label: Space-Saving & Decorative Garden Accent
items.value: Perfect for pots, raised beds, or borders. Encourages vertical growth while adding structure and elegance to small indoor or outdoor spaces.
